label: preserve
contract: A string or number in override replaces a dictionary in base, and a dictionary in override replaces a string or number in base.
visible_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"db": {"host": "a", "port": 1}, "x": 1}, {"db": "sqlite:///app.db"}, {"db": "sqlite:///app.db", "x": 1}),
    ({"retry": {"max": 3}}, {"retry": 5}, {"retry": 5}),
    ({"log": "info", "y": 2}, {"log": {"level": "debug"}}, {"log": {"level": "debug"}, "y": 2}),
    ({"pool": 4}, {"pool": {"min": 1}}, {"pool": {"min": 1}}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)
heldout_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"cache": {"size": 10}, "name": "svc"}, {"cache": "off"}, {"cache": "off", "name": "svc"}),

    ({"theme": "dark"}, {"theme": {"name": "light"}}, {"theme": {"name": "light"}}),
    ({"timeout": 30, "z": 0}, {"timeout": {"read": 5}}, {"timeout": {"read": 5}, "z": 0}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: merge_config does not modify base or override, or anything they contain.
visible_check:
import copy
from config_merge import merge_config
base = {"name": "app", "tags": ["a"], "db": {"host": "h", "port": 1, "replicas": ["r1"]}}
override = {"db": {"port": 2, "replicas": ["r2"]}, "tags": ["b", "c"], "debug": True}
before = copy.deepcopy((base, override))
merge_config(base, override)
assert (base, override) == before, (base, override)
heldout_check:
import copy
from config_merge import merge_config
base = {"level": "warn", "hosts": ["x"], "smtp": {"host": "m", "tls": False, "to": ["ops"]}}
override = {"smtp": {"tls": True, "to": ["dev", "qa"]}, "hosts": ["y"], "port": 25}
before = copy.deepcopy((base, override))
merge_config(base, override)
assert (base, override) == before, (base, override)

label: arbitrary
contract: When base and override both have a dictionary under the same key, the two are merged key by key at any depth: for nested strings and numbers, keys from either side are kept and override's value wins.
visible_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"db": {"host": "h", "port": 5432}, "name": "a"}, {"db": {"port": 6543}},
     {"db": {"host": "h", "port": 6543}, "name": "a"}),
    ({"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 2}, "e": 3}}, {"a": {"b": {"d": 4}, "f": 5}},
     {"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 4}, "e": 3, "f": 5}}),
    ({"log": {"level": "info", "fmt": "json"}}, {"log": {"level": "debug"}},
     {"log": {"level": "debug", "fmt": "json"}}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)
heldout_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"smtp": {"host": "m", "port": 25}, "debug": False}, {"smtp": {"host": "mail"}},
     {"smtp": {"host": "mail", "port": 25}, "debug": False}),
    ({"x": {"y": {"z": 1, "w": 2}, "v": "k"}, "q": 0}, {"x": {"y": {"z": 9}, "n": 5}},
     {"x": {"y": {"z": 9, "w": 2}, "v": "k", "n": 5}, "q": 0}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: A top-level key whose value in override is None keeps its value from base, or stays absent if base lacks it.
visible_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"a": 1, "b": "x", "db": {"h": 1}, "n": 5, "on": True},
     {"a": None, "db": None, "n": 0, "on": False, "c": 3},
     {"a": 1, "b": "x", "db": {"h": 1}, "n": 0, "on": False, "c": 3}),
    ({"p": True}, {"q": None}, {"p": True}),
    ({"mode": "fast", "k": 2}, {"mode": None}, {"mode": "fast", "k": 2}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)

label: arbitrary
contract: When base and override both have a list under the same top-level key, the result has base's list followed by override's list.
visible_check:
from config_merge import merge_config
for base, override, want in (
    ({"plugins": ["a", "b"], "x": 1}, {"plugins": ["b", "c"]}, {"plugins": ["a", "b", "b", "c"], "x": 1}),
    ({"ids": [1]}, {"ids": [2, 1]}, {"ids": [1, 2, 1]}),
):
    got = merge_config(base, override)
    assert got == want, (override, got)
heldout_check:

for base, override, want in (
